findings.claim: The two foundation rows are visually identical empty suit slots under one 'FOUNDATIONS' heading, and neither the board nor How to play says which row is the up pile (A,2,3...) and which is the down pile (K,Q,J...). A novice who drags an Ace to the lower row gets a silent snap-back with no message, no highlight and no hint that the row was the wrong end - the app's central twist is the one thing the board never labels.

repro: Tap 'Deal #<n>' pill (row 2, ~x=196 y=175); backspace the prefilled value 6x at (333,775); type 1,0,0,1,1; tap Play at (276,392) -> deal #10011
Tap 'How to play' (55,214): the Goal section names an up pile and a down pile but never says which screen row is which. Tap Done (359,103)
Tap col2 bottom 8D at (126,650) -> it builds onto 9S, exposing AS
DRAG AS from (126,620) to the LOWER spade foundation slot (28,374): card snaps back, Moves stays 6, no message (screenshot tc11-04)
Control: DRAG the same AS from (126,620) to the UPPER spade slot (28,296): it is accepted (screenshot tc11-05) - so the refusal above is a rule refusal, not a failed pickup

findings.note: Not a blocker for WF-1: tap-to-smart-move routes an Ace to the up row and a King to the down row correctly, so a novice can finish the workflow without ever knowing. Cheapest fix is a ghost 'A' / 'K' (or an up/down chevron) watermark on the EMPTY foundation slots plus one clause in How to play - do not restyle occupied foundations.
